studio.ed.styles-note: One tap for a finished look. Everything stays adjustable, then Export.
studio.ed.highlight-note: The word being recited changes colour, timed from the reciter's own words.
studio.ed.untimed: This reciter has no word timings, so the whole ayah shows at once (never guessed).
studio.ed.pickTimed: Choose a reciter with word timings
studio.ed.highlight-needs-timings: This recitation has no word timings, so words can't be lit (never guessed).
studio.ed.touches-note: Calm effects on the background and soft light; the Quran text is never moved or bent. Up to {n} at once, plus Cinematic, Grain and Vignette.
studio.ed.darken-note: How dark the background gets behind the text: from none to almost black. A little keeps the ayah easy to read.
studio.ed.order-note: Scenes keep their lengths; only the order changes.
studio.ed.scene-adjust-note: For this scene only. Blur softens a busy background so the ayah stands out.
studio.ed.nature-note: A calm nature sound under the recitation. Even at full volume it stays far quieter than the reciter. Never music. Preview = export.
studio.ed.frame-note: Show whole keeps landscape videos and photos complete, over a soft blurred copy that fills the frame. Fill crops them to the frame.
studio.ed.echo-note: Shapes the reciter's own voice as if in a room, a hall or a masjid: nothing else is added. Space = how big, Tail = how long it rings, Repeats = the voice coming back. Preview = export.
studio.ed.cinema-note: The words glow softly with the reciter's voice; the scene rises out of darkness, drifts slowly closer, softens behind the ayah and settles back into darkness at the end. The reference always stays.
studio.ed.tight-note: The video opens just before the voice: only the silence at the start is trimmed, never a word. The pauses between ayat stay natural.
studio.qr.feel-tahajjud: slow and quiet, words lit in soft gold
studio.qr.feel-golden: warm and still, written in gold
studio.qr.vibe-note: Tap another vibe to change it. Each one sets the background, colours, motion and pauses.
studio.qr.vibe-note-footage: Tap another vibe to change it. Your footage is kept; the colours, motion and pauses change.
studio.qr.title: Quick reel
studio.qr.footage-note: What would you like behind the ayah? Pick a kind, then tap up to 4 clips. They play in the order you tap them. Remembered for next time.
studio.qr.no-library: The free library is not set up in this build, so the built-in scenes are used. Tap Next.
studio.qr.footage-credit: Free clips from Pixabay, downloaded only when you tap one. The creator is credited on the export page.
studio.qr.motion-note: How the text appears. Calm motions only; ink reveal runs right to left on the Arabic.
studio.qr.mark-note: Pixabay clips carry no watermark. The surah reference always stays on the video.
studio.qr.finish-note: Everything stays adjustable in the other tools before you export.
studio.ed.format-note: 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and Shorts; square for feeds and WhatsApp; 16:9 for YouTube and screens. The text is laid out again for each.
studio.ed.learn-note: One word at a time with its English meaning large beneath it, timed to the reciter. Word meanings from Quran.com.
studio.ed.learn-needs-timings: Learning reels need this reciter's word timings; pick a reciter with word timings.
studio.ed.series-note: Split a longer passage into reels of about the same length, never inside an ayah. Each part gets this look and "Part 1 of N" on its closing card, and waits in Drafts.
studio.ed.series-too-many: That is more than 30 parts; pick an earlier ayah or longer parts.
studio.ed.series-failed: The series could not be saved
studio.ed.tajweed-note: Colours the letters by tajweed rule, from Quran.com's tajweed data. The text itself never changes; the recited word still lights up over it.
studio.ed.tajweed-failed: Tajweed colours could not be loaded
studio.ed.dedication-note: Your own words on the closing card, under the reference, in a plain font, never near the ayah. Turns the closing card on.
studio.ed.trust-timed: Quran text exact (KFGQPC Uthmani Hafs) · words synced to {r}'s own recitation
studio.ed.trust-ayah: Quran text exact (KFGQPC Uthmani Hafs) · whole ayat, recited by {r}, no timing guessed
studio.ed.cap-make: Make this reel yourself in Ayah Studio: {link}
studio.ed.caption-shared: Caption copied: paste it into your post
studio.ed.caption: Caption
studio.ed.caption-note: Caption, ready to paste (you can edit it):
studio.ed.text-size-note: 0 % is the smallest size that stays easy to read on a phone; Medium is {m} %. Long ayat wrap onto more lines instead of shrinking further.
studio.ed.slowmo-note: Slows the background videos (0.75× or 0.5×) for a calmer feel. The recitation is never slowed.
studio.qr.split-note-ayah: A new clip with each ayah, changing in the pause between ayat. They play in the order you tapped them.
studio.qr.split-note-even: The clips share the reel equally, in the order you tapped them.

studio.qr.modes-need-timings: This recitation has no word timings, so only the whole ayah can be shown (never guessed).

studio.mk.logo-note: A PNG with a transparent background looks best. Kept on this device only.
studio.mk.too-big: That image is too large (over 8 MB).
studio.mk.unreadable: That image could not be read.
studio.ed.tail-note: Silent: no sound is added. The background, the reference and your mark keep going. You can also drag the first audio block or the end of the timeline.
studio.mk.drag-note: Drag your mark on the preview to move it along the top or the bottom.
studio.mk.keys-note: Add a keyframe, move the playhead, then drag your mark or change its size: it glides between keyframes along its strip.
studio.mk.keys-note-on: Drag your mark or change Size here at the playhead: a keyframe is set there. Size above is the largest it gets.

front.ob.hi: Assalamu alaikum! I’m so glad you’re here.
front.ob.few: A few quick questions, and I’ll shape your first days around you.
front.ob.read: A few pages a day, and a flame that keeps you going. I love it.
front.ob.memorise: Memorising! I’ll keep a short lesson ready for you every day.
front.ob.understand: Then we’ll read with the meaning beside every ayah.
front.ob.reels: You’ll make beautiful reels with a reciter, right on your phone.
front.ob.dhikr: Morning and evening adhkar, tasbih and du’as. I’ll walk with you through the day.
front.ob.many: Wonderful. We’ll make room for all of it, one step at a time.
front.ob.none: No problem. We’ll find what you love together.
front.ob.pages: How many pages a day would you like to read?
front.ob.pagesHint: Reading them lights your flame for the day. You can change it any time on Me.
front.ob.p1: One page a day. Small, steady steps go a long way, and I’ll be with you for every one.
front.ob.p2: Two pages a day finishes the whole Quran in about ten months. Let’s do it!
front.ob.p5: Five pages a day! That’s the whole Quran in about four months. MashaAllah!
front.ob.p10: Ten pages a day: a whole Quran in about two months. I’m excited already!
front.ob.p20: Twenty pages is a juz a day. The whole Quran every month. MashaAllah!
front.ob.tasbihHint: I’ll count with you on the tasbih counter, bead by bead.
front.ob.t0: That’s fine. The tasbih counter is waiting on Me whenever you want it.
front.ob.t33: Thirty-three a day, under a minute. I’ll count every one with you.
front.ob.t100: A hundred a day, about two minutes. I’ll keep the count for you.
front.ob.t300: Three hundred a day! Let’s keep those beads moving together.
front.ob.t1000: A thousand a day. MashaAllah, that’s real devotion. I’ll be right here counting.

ranks.rk.title: Ranks
ranks.rk.sub: Read, listen and make reels together
ranks.rk.outLine: Join a league of 15 readers this week. Only what the app checks itself counts.
ranks.rk.outSub: Sign in with Google to join this week’s league, the global board and boards with your family and friends. Only what the app checks itself counts: pages read for their full time, recitation really played, surahs finished and reels made.
ranks.rk.iPtsBody: XP has this violet mark. Everything you do in the app earns it. This week's XP decides your place in your league and on every board, and starts again from 0 when the week ends at Friday's Maghrib. All the XP you have ever earned gives your character its level. XP is never spent.
ranks.rk.eaPageSub: Counts once it has been on screen for its reading time ({t} min, set in Me → ⚙). Up to 60 a day
ranks.rk.eaFlawlessSub: Extra, for a new lesson with no mistakes
ranks.rk.eaDaySub: Once a day, for any of the above
ranks.rk.iLightBody: Light has the star. It comes from chests (goals, adhkar, prizes) and you spend it in the shop. Light never counts in Ranks, and XP never turns into Light.
ranks.rk.iLeagueBody: Each week you play with up to {size} people at your level. The leagues follow the Sahaba's journey in order: Dar al-Arqam, Hijrah, Badr, Al-Khandaq, Fath Makkah. A later league is only later in the story, never a better Companion. The week runs Saturday to Friday and ends at Maghrib on Friday, at your own Maghrib where you live. Leagues are made of people on nearby clocks, and results show once everyone's Maghrib has passed. The top {up} move up a tier and win prizes, the bottom {down} move down.
ranks.rk.iWhenBody: A few seconds after a page counts, a lesson is passed or a minute is played, when you are online. While Ranks is open, the board updates by itself.
ranks.rk.notLight: XP is your progress here and is never spent. Light (✦) from chests is for the shop and never counts in Ranks.
